name: NGC 6872, eastern tidal tail (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 6872, eastern tidal tail, part of a giant barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc6872e-hubble
story: This field follows the long eastern tidal tail of NGC 6872, a giant barred spiral stretched by its encounter with the small galaxy IC 4970. Hubble studied the tail to learn how star clusters form in the debris of galaxy encounters.

claims.text: The target NGC 6872E is the eastern tidal tail of NGC 6872
NGC 6872's eastern tidal tail is long, with the galaxy's center lying to the west
NGC 6872 is a giant barred spiral galaxy interacting with the small disk galaxy IC 4970
Program 15083 studies star clusters in tidal tails
